title: Transformation
idea: Transformation (Brief doc tab "Transformation", #44). Matcha Fuel's "Drink this once a day. Inflammation doesn't stand a chance" (159 days live) swapped to skin tags, same beat order: challenge hook → premium → proof → comparison → mechanism → bonus benefits → why it's affordable → product → easy → offer → CTA. Skin tags = our lowest-sophistication angle. Backed by Matcha Fuel (159 days) + our launched skin tag winners #156 (mechanism wording) and #78 (Day 1→4), and the dermatologist-cost beat from #316.

editing_notes:
Replicate this format exactly: Reference (link above). Matcha Fuel "Drink this once a day. Inflammation doesn't stand a chance" (159 days live), swapped to skin tags.

BEAT ORDER (same as the reference): challenge hook → premium grade → proof → comparison → mechanism → bonus benefits → why it's affordable → product → easy → offer → CTA. Every beat = one or two fast B-roll shots, matched to the reference timestamp in the Visual column. Fast VO + B-roll montage, no talking head. Every clip based on something real: real women, real small skin tags, our real product photos (Products tab).
CAPTIONS: small white captions in grey boxes, centred low, like the reference. Hook headline: white text on a red box at the top (ref 0:00).
PROOF RULE: the reference shows a study screenshot; there is no real skin tag study, so we show REAL reviews from our Skin Tags page instead. Never fake a study, a number or a review.
OFFER: early Black Friday Buy 1 Get 1 Free + "if the tag is still there, we refund you, keep the bottle" (both on our Skin Tags page). Landing page: Skin Tags page.
CLAIMS: "cuts off its blood supply... dries out and falls off" = Johnny's launched #156 wording (removal claim). Softer back-up line if Meta rejects it: "...so it dries out and shrinks on its own."
Doc: Brief H+S, tab "Transformation".

Voiceover: Female, 30s-40s, confident and fast, "you need to know about this" energy, exactly the reference's pace (about 60 s). NEEDS TO HAVE CONVICTION in their voice, its boring to listen to a dull script. They need to speak with character.

Avatar: No talking head (like the reference). Real-looking women 35 to 60 in short B-roll clips: rolling our roller on a small skin tag (neck, eyelid, underarm), holding the bottle and smiling (like ref 0:21-0:27), one shocked face (ref 0:33), one pointing down at the end (ref 1:03). Real skin texture, small realistic tags.
